dialogues.speaker: Sasaki
dialogues.text: What's this Iro... Irodory Festival thing again? What's it supposed to be?

dialogues.speaker: Sasaki
dialogues.text: And there's a ton of people here too. I must admit that it's got me a little muddle-headed.

dialogues.speaker: Sasaki
dialogues.text: Still, it's good to see our pampered Lady do work out there, so I suppose I can't complain.
